action: Starts from a small low-res egg/oval head DynaMesh with only faint brow and eye-socket dents, then pulls the nose tip forward as a single pointed cone from the front view with a very large brush.
why: Get the nose projection and facial mass in one big move before any detail.
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh on a UV sphere, then Grab brush with large radius pulling the nose tip forward (X symmetry on).

action: Rotates to 3/4 and side views to cut the jaw/cheek plane and push in the eye sockets, giving a narrow V-shaped jaw and a sharp pointed nose in profile.
why: Set the anime jaw silhouette and side profile early.
reader_equivalent: Grab + Flatten/Scrape on the jaw planes, checked in side ortho view.

action: Masks the lower face (dark mask over the mouth area), cuts a straight mouth line, then builds brow ridge, nose and a smiling mouth with lip bulge; DynaMesh resolution stays low while blocking.
why: Place the main features as simple planes and lines on a low-res mesh that can still be remeshed freely.
reader_equivalent: Mask brush / box mask, Draw Sharp or Crease for the mouth line, Grab for the lip bulge, voxel remesh at low resolution.

action: Carves the eyes as almond outlines with an upper lid crease and a lower lid line directly into the face plane, wide-set and low on the head, with a long upper-lid line.
why: Anime eyes are read as lines and planes, not as round eyeballs.
reader_equivalent: Crease brush (negative) or Draw Sharp for lid lines; Flatten for the eye plane.

action: Ears appear as a separate piece positioned with the Gizmo transform tool at the side of the head, then blended.
why: Ears are placed and scaled as an object rather than pulled out of the skull.
reader_equivalent: Separate ear mesh moved with the transform gizmo (G/S/R), then joined + voxel remesh or kept as separate object.

action: Refines the nose by masking it (dark mask) and shaping around it, sculpts the ear helix and inner folds, and checks the face from below.
why: Protect the nose while reshaping nearby cheek; check from below for symmetry and depth.
reader_equivalent: Mask brush then Clay Strips/Smooth around it; rotate to bottom view to check.

action: Sculpts a small iris disc and pupil dimple inside each eye opening, deepens lid creases, then checks the profile (pointed nose, shallow eye) and the front.
why: Give the eye a readable iris bump within the shallow socket.
reader_equivalent: Draw/Inflate with small radius for the iris dome, Crease for lid lines.

action: Zooms out to see the whole head with ears, then raises DynaMesh resolution and smooths the face into soft clean planes.
why: Go from blocky to soft only after the features are placed.
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh with smaller voxel size, then Smooth brush.

action: Draws the anime line art on the smooth face: sharp tapered upper lash lines, eyebrows, iris rings with lash ticks under the eye, as thin dark strokes.
tool: Thin stroke brush; dark lines likely polypaint or very shallow carve (inferred)
why: Anime eyes are mostly graphic lines over a simple surface.
reader_equivalent: Texture Paint or Draw Sharp at very low strength for line art; or Crease for shallow grooves.

action: Cross-fades to the finished Gojo bust: spiky separate hair spikes, cloth blindfold with folds, hand over the face, high collar.
